figures.caption: Structural characterization of the designed peptides. figures.caption: Binding isotherms derived by plotting fractions of the membrane-bound peptide (F – F0)/(Fmax – F0) as a function of the concentration of the lipid. The Trp fluorescence intensity at 295 nm was recorded by titrating 10 μM of the peptides with increasing molar concentrations of SUVs in 10 mM TES buffer (pH 7.4). Data were fitted (OriginLab Corp.) with the hyperbolic saturation curve for DMPC/DMPG (7:3, w/w) in the case of Ana-4 (pink, ●), Ana-5 (green, ▲), and indolicidin (red, ▼), whereas for the parent peptide α-MSH(6–13) (blue, ■), due to weak initial binding, the data points could not be fitted with the same.
